name: @aura/automation
description: AURA Automation Engine — event-driven engineering workflows. Rules react to real platform moments (mission completed, diagnosis accepted, file / README / dependency changes, PR merged) by running chains of real actions (diagnosis, governance audits, knowledge update, engineering memory) with conditions, retries, logs, history and an execution timeline. The package is a pure state machine over persisted state — all side effects are injected by the host.
